about: Files moved here byte for byte from the original Bitfield package packages/visual-database that no Workshop or apps copy held (tests and fixtures, expression authoring, migrations and their targets, record form, tables home, mounts, selection binding, iOS JavaScriptCore mount, direct-view data, proof and performance evidence). Each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. Only the listed calls differ.

calls.means: This repository is public and holds made-up data only: the account name of the computer the package was written on, in a home-folder path or an environment value, becomes a made-up one. Nothing else in the file changes.
A path into the maker's private notes, named as notes/ instead.
